scope: The circa-1890 exterior of the former Portuguese fort in Ouidah, including its low enclosure and the roofs and volumes visible in the two period records. The 1960s museum conversion is outside the represented period.

originalReview.notes: Contemporary 1888 Sociedade Geográfica de Lisboa plan fixes the enclosure organization and the relationships between interior buildings.

references.filename: Fort of São João Baptista de Ajudá (1890).jpg

originalReview.notes: The 1890 front elevation in the 1901 publication shows low plastered walls, the rectangular two-story front volume and subordinate roof silhouettes.

quallaSearch.notes: Two exact Qualla archival originals match native Commons revisions and file hashes. The 1888 published geographical-society plan and the period illustration published in 1901 are public-domain works. The 1932 photo is outside the chosen period and its unknown-author rights record was not used.
